I did two Facebook live videos one after trying the 5k headset, and below that is the video I filmed live with the 8k headset.

The really good news is that if you are in San Francisco you can try the Pimax 8k headset at our next event on October 20th the event is called San Francisco Virtual Reality 360 but you must get a ticket soon because we are selling out fast! https://www.eventbrite.com/e/san-francisco-virtual-reality-360-octo-tickets-38469924580
